nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How can improving traceability in seafood production help regain consumer confidence, as discussed by Stowaway et al. (2008)?
nodes.answer: By enhancing traceability, consumers can have greater transparency and trust in the origin and processing of seafood products, leading to increased consumer confidence in the industry.

nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What is the importance of traceability in seafood production according to Stowaway et al. (2008)?
nodes.answer: Traceability in seafood production is crucial for improving consumer confidence and ensuring the quality and safety of seafood products.

nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How can digital technologies help overcome barriers to achieve sustainable production and consumption in the food sector?
nodes.answer: Digital technologies can help overcome barriers by improving traceability, efficiency, and transparency in food supply chains, ultimately promoting sustainability in production and consumption.
